title: One sentence, three candidate spaces
description: Reproduce the official README example conceptually: change only the eligible languages and inspect how the documented top label and normalized score move.
sourceNote: Outputs shown here are the values documented by the upstream project, not a new benchmark run.

profiles.label: Bundled 97-language model
profiles.detail: Leave the complete pre-trained label space active.
profiles.explanation: English wins, but it competes with the full bundled label set. The normalized score is lower than in the two-language configuration because the comparison set is broader.

profiles.label: German, French, or Italian
profiles.detail: Apply a product policy that accidentally excludes English.
profiles.explanation: The classifier cannot return English, so Italian wins among the remaining labels with a very high normalized score. Confidence cannot compensate for an invalid candidate policy.

profiles.label: English or Italian
profiles.detail: Narrow the scope while keeping the reference language eligible.
profiles.explanation: English remains eligible and wins a two-language comparison. The larger score describes this narrower competition; it does not make the text itself more informative.
